snippet.title: Graffism VR Official Trailer - Graffiti simulator - VR Graffiti Game
snippet.description:
Welcome to the world of Graffism where you can paint with advance realistic spray mechanics on mostly everywhere you reach. Get creative with different tools like fire extinguisher, mop, chisel marker and 750ml cans with variety of caps! Available on Meta Quest!

Website: https://graffism.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/graffism.vr/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@graffism.vr
Discord: https://discord.gg/HgpSK2S8

#graffiti #metaquest2 #metaquest3 #vrgaming
